Head of Data / CDO.title: Head of Data / Chief Data Officer (CDO)
Head of Data / CDO.description: Responsible for the company's data strategy, governance, and the overall value derived from data assets
key_concerns: Demonstrating AI ROI and business value to executive leadership
Reducing data silos and fragmentation to enable end-to-end analytics and AI
Ensuring data governance, quality, and compliance for all AI workloads
Head of Data / CDO.roi_focus: Measurable business value and ROI from AI initiatives
evaluation_criteria: Unified platform for data quality, governance, and delivery
Governance and compliance capabilities
Scalability of the data foundation
Ability to demonstrate measurable ROI to the board
Head of Data / CDO.core_need: Establish a unified, trusted, and scalable data foundation that accelerates business value from AI initiatives and delivers measurable ROI to the board
Head of Data / CDO.why_striim: Striim provides a unified, intelligent data platform, giving the CDO a single platform to control data quality, governance, and delivery for all AI projects. This transforms data from a liability into a strategic asset for AI.

VP of AI.title: VP of AI / Applied AI
VP of AI.description: Business leader responsible for defining and executing the company's AI strategy to drive business outcomes; the AI champion and P&L owner
key_concerns: Demonstrating clear, quantifiable ROI from AI projects
Accelerating the time-to-market for new AI-powered products and services
Establishing a scalable, repeatable framework for AI development and deployment
VP of AI.roi_focus: Quantifiable ROI and time-to-market for AI products
evaluation_criteria: Access to fresh, high-quality, governed data for models
Speed of moving AI pilots into production
Repeatability and scalability of the AI framework
Measurable business outcomes
VP of AI.core_need: Rapidly deliver measurable business value from AI initiatives and scale successful AI pilots into production
VP of AI.why_striim: Striim provides the foundational infrastructure that turns AI concepts into reality. By ensuring models have access to fresh, high-quality, governed data, Striim helps the VP of AI achieve their mandate and move from AI ambition to tangible business outcomes.

VP of Engineering / CTO.title: VP of Engineering / CTO
VP of Engineering / CTO.description: Responsible for technology strategy, platform selection, and the operational reliability of data systems
key_concerns: Achieving sub-second latency for real-time applications and AI
Ensuring enterprise-grade availability and elastic scalability
Reducing the engineering burden and total cost of ownership of managing complex data pipelines
VP of Engineering / CTO.roi_focus: Reduced operational overhead and total cost of ownership
evaluation_criteria: Performance and latency (sub-second)
Availability, resilience, and elastic scalability
Fully managed SaaS vs. DIY maintenance burden
Features like CDC and automated schema evolution
VP of Engineering / CTO.core_need: Deploy and manage a real-time data infrastructure that is high-performance, resilient, and reduces operational overhead without requiring extensive custom development
VP of Engineering / CTO.why_striim: Striim's fully managed SaaS platform with features like Change Data Capture (CDC), automated schema evolution, and elastic scalability allows them to operationalize AI without needing a large, specialized team to build and maintain a DIY stack.

Data Scientist.title: Data Scientist
Data Scientist.description: Builds, trains, and deploys machine learning models
key_concerns: Eliminating data staleness and manual data preparation time
Accessing diverse data sources in a single, unified stream
Data accuracy and quality for model training and inference
Data Scientist.roi_focus: Time saved on data preparation, model quality
evaluation_criteria: Data freshness and quality of streams
Breadth of source connectivity in a unified stream
In-stream enrichment (vector embeddings, anomaly detection)
Ease of integration with model workflows
Data Scientist.core_need: Access fresh, high-quality, and context-rich data streams for model training and inference without spending time on data plumbing
Data Scientist.why_striim: Striim's platform delivers decision-ready data streams, allowing data scientists to focus on model development rather than data plumbing. Its in-stream AI agents for vector embeddings and anomaly detection enrich the data for direct use by AI models.

AI Product Manager.title: AI Product Manager
AI Product Manager.description: Owns intelligent applications and AI-powered product features from concept to launch
key_concerns: Real-time data availability for product experiences
Governing data for compliance and accuracy in customer-facing AI
AI Product Manager.roi_focus: Faster feature delivery, product adoption and outcomes
evaluation_criteria: Speed from prototype to production
Reliability of real-time data feeding the product
Governance and compliance for customer-facing AI
Reduced dependency on engineering for data access
AI Product Manager.core_need: Ship real-time, AI-powered product features quickly on data that is fresh, governed, and production-ready
AI Product Manager.why_striim: Striim delivers decision-ready, governed data streams that let product teams ship real-time AI features faster, without waiting on custom pipeline work from engineering.

CISO.title: Security & Compliance Officer (CISO)
CISO.description: Ensures data privacy, security, and compliance across the organization's IT infrastructure
key_concerns: Preventing data breaches and unauthorized access to production data
Meeting regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI, EU AI Act)
Maintaining a continuous audit trail for data lineage and validation
evaluation_criteria: In-flight sensitive data detection and masking
Regulatory compliance coverage
Continuous data validation and audit trail
Protection of production data from exposure
CISO.core_need: Ensure data privacy, security, and compliance across all AI and data pipelines, especially with sensitive data
CISO.why_striim: Striim's AI-powered data governance agents (e.g., Sentinel AI) detect and mask sensitive data in flight, ensuring a cleansed and protected operational replica is delivered to AI systems without exposing production data. The Validata feature provides continuous data validation for audit readiness.
